==Transportation== [[File:Barrows Map.png|thumb|right|295px| 1. (Red) Using the [[Barrows Teleport]] ([[Barrows teleport (tablet)|tab]]) is the quickest route.
2. (Blue, Green and Orange) Using the [[Minigame Teleport|Mort'ton minigame teleport]], [[Mort'ton teleport|Mort'ton teleport scroll]] and [[Morytania legs 3]] & [[Morytania legs 4|4]] are good alternatives to players who don't have access to the Barrows teleport.
3. (Pink and Light blue) Travelling using the [[Swamp Boaty]] is a valid method for ironmen who don't have access to abovementioned options.
4. (Yellow) Using the {{Fairycode|BIP}} fairy ring is the longest of the routes, but takes the player close to the [[Nature Grotto]], which players can visit to restore their prayer points.]] There are several different methods for travelling to the Barrows. The best options, ordered from fast to slow, are: *Casting [[Barrows Teleport]] in the [[Arceuus spellbook]] (requires level 83 [[Magic]]), or using a [[Barrows teleport (tablet)|Barrows teleport tablet]] or [[Portal Chamber|house portal]] to teleport right next to the entrance. *Using the [[Mort'ton teleport]] scroll and then running east to Barrows. *Using the [[Morytania legs 3]] or [[Morytania legs 4|4]] to [[Burgh de Rott]] and running north through [[Mort'ton]] towards Barrows. *Using the [[Minigame Teleport]] to [[Shades of Mort'ton (minigame)|Shades of Mort'ton]] (requires completion of the [[Shades of Mort'ton]] quest). This method is free and takes up no inventory or equipment spaces, though there is a 20-minute cooldown between uses. *Casting [[Kharyrll Teleport]] in the [[Ancient Magicks|Ancient spellbook]] (requires level 66 Magic and completion of [[Desert Treasure I]]), or using a [[Kharyrll teleport (tablet)|Kharyrll teleport tablet]] or house portal to teleport to [[Canifis]], then using the [[Myreque Hideout]] shortcut south of the pub and running south, crossing the rope bridge, continuing south and using the [[Swamp Boaty|swamp boaty]] to travel to Mort'ton, then running east. *Using the [[Fairy rings|fairy ring]] code {{Fairycode|BKR}}, running south-east and using the swamp boaty to travel to Mort'ton, then running east. *Using the fairy ring code {{Fairycode|bip}}, hopping across the [[Stepping stone (Mort Myre Swamp)|stepping stone]] shortcut (requires level 50 [[Agility]]), then going east and south, following the path through Mort'ton. *Using [[Drakan's medallion]] to teleport to [[Ver Sinhaza]] (requires completion of [[A Taste of Hope]]), leaving through the western door, running south-west to board the [[Boat (Darkness of Hallowvale)|boat]] to Burgh de Rott, and running north through Mort'ton to Barrows. *Running east from Canifis, then south through the swamp, turning east at the northmost hunter spot, looping around to the other nearby hunter spot, then running south-west to the swamp exit. Non-[[Ironman Mode|Ironman]] players may attempt to visit a [[player-owned house]] on a [[house party]] world with a [[portal nexus]] for a quick and cheap teleport to Barrows or Canifis. Additionally, players with level 72 [[Agility]] can use the [[Dry stone wall (Barrows)|dry stone wall]] shortcut on the south west side of the mounds, just east of the bridge.
